svg.title: Manager sign-in - dark (app default)
svg.desc: Real render of Manager sign-in - dark (app default) - the screen is an embedded PNG, every chip, number and label is vector text.

g.text: Splash artwork - full-bleed behind the sheet
Sheet header - back affordance and title
Phone field - country dial code and number
Forgot password - opens the reset sheet
Quick access - switch to email sign-in
